svg.title: Organization of the Islamic Republic of Iran: Regime & Security Apparatus (November 2026) & Fall-of-System Event Scenarios

g.text: ORGANIZATION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
REGIME GOVERNANCE, COERCIVE & SECURITY APPARATUS — AS OF NOVEMBER 2026
TIER 3 — OPERATIONAL SECURITY, INTELLIGENCE & CIVILIAN PILLARS

text.tspan: Commander-in-Chief of All Armed Forces & Ultimate Policy Arbiter
Governs via written decrees & closed military meetings; unseen publicly
Predecessor: Ali Khamenei KIA Feb 28, 2026 (US-Israeli strikes)
Leader's Reps: M. Rezaei & Saeed Jalili
Prev. Sec: Ali Larijani KIA Mar 17, 2026
Core collective security & Hormuz policy hub
Prev. Chief: A. Mousavi KIA Feb 28, 2026
Ordered to integrate with Khatam al-Anbiya
C-in-C: Maj. Gen. Ahmad Vahidi (appt. Aug 10, 2026) | Deputy: Maj. Gen. Mostafa Izadi
3rd C-in-C in 14 mos: M. Pakpour KIA Feb 28, 2026 & H. Salami KIA Jun 2025
Core regime guardian: asymmetric warfare, strategic missiles, domestic control & economy

g.text: Clerical Vetting / Ideological Control / Informal Influence

Sources: FRS (2026), FDD Long War Journal (Nov 2026), Anadolu Agency (Aug 2026), CTP-ISW (Aug 2026), The New Arab (Nov 2026), NIAC (Nov 2026). Chart architecture adapted from CIA NIS (1973) via Wikimedia Commons.
